class.name: LibraryWorkbench
class.brief_description: Quick inspection panel (Workbench) for the Zyris Library.
class.description: [LibraryWorkbench] hosts a dedicated [EditorInspector] to allow immediate editing of properties for resources selected within the Library, without needing to open the resource in the main panel.

method.name: edit_object
method.description: Switches the internal [EditorInspector] to edit the specified object.
